summary: Compute line totals in whole dollars, which rounds every amount. Hand-written harness check, not model output.

edits.search: line_total_cents: quantity as i64 * unit_price_cents as i64,
edits.replace: line_total_cents: ((quantity as f64 * unit_price_cents as f64) / 100.0).round() as i64 * 100,
